scope.ageInterpretation: Official stage window with stage-end attainment, not identical performance due at every age.

coverageMeaning: Dispositions separate directly representable shared-operation authoring, conditional script or inherited-gate representation, and contextual engagement. Framework task design accounts for source requirements without selecting a national language pair. It does not certify learner attainment or transfer English mastery to another language.

contributions.contribution: Direct shared operation; language-specific success and whole-topic mastery are not inferred from the association.

records.rationale: The source permits syllable analysis. The complete existing operation counts, joins and separates spoken syllables and uses an expert-checked pronunciation division beside a familiar written word as a reading aid. It does not require English consonant clusters or a fixed English sound inventory.

Existing print understanding fixes left-to-right direction; that whole claim is not universal across the role framework. The parameterised task instead checks the actual book layout, word boundaries, reading path and punctuation conventions of the selected script.
remainingConditions: Bind the actual language/script and qualified assessment materials before use; no universal English substitution.

records.rationale: The existing all-letters claim explicitly requires 26 English letters in two cases. It cannot represent every script inventory or akshar system. The role-bound inventory contract retains recognition and productive use without inventing an alphabet or cloning an English claim.
remainingConditions: Bind the actual language/script and qualified assessment materials before use; no universal English substitution.

consumerBoundary: Associations record shared authoring contributions only. Current scoped contexts do not encode the actual learner language or script. Consumers must not interpret one topic estimate as evidence of R1 and R2 attainment; language/material binding is an independent application responsibility. No learner state, schema or scoring changes are authorised.
